title: Zephyr: Rule 4 decompression
description: Implement Rule 4 CoAP decompression in Zephyr C. Acceptance: decompresses to original headers, cross-validates.
notes: Implemented current-spec Zephyr wire Rule 4 decompression for canonical link-local IPv6 + ICMPv6 RPL DAO with DODAGID; stale CoAP/UDP tracker wording does not control. Decoder now enforces the 22554-byte encoded profile ceiling, rejects all truncated 36-byte residues and D-flag-clear noncanonical residues before output mutation, parses the exact byte-aligned 288-bit residue, preserves the following opaque DAO option tail, bounds reconstructed lengths/output atomically, writes reserved=0, rebuilds IPv6/ICMPv6/DAO lengths and checksum, and supports the exact size boundary. Rule 4 has no padding bits because its residue is exactly byte aligned; subsequent bytes are tail by spec. Validation: sanitizer-backed focused CMake/ctest PASS 1/1; Rule 4 compression regression PASS 1/1; Rule 7 regression PASS 1/1; Python Rule 4 PASS 13; Rust canonical codec/header tests PASS 2; cppcheck PASS.
close_reason: Implemented and cross-validated atomic current-spec Zephyr SCHC Rule 4 decompression
